description: Fetch a public web page (article, blog post, docs page, README, Wikipedia...) and return its main content as clean Markdown and/or plain text, with nav, ads, footers and comments removed, plus title, author, publish date, word count and reading time. Does not run JavaScript; paywalled pages return only public content.

max_chars.description: Truncate the content to N characters to fit your context budget (0 = no limit)

url.description: Public http(s) URL to read (scheme optional)

name: extract_url
title: Extract URL to Markdown
